summary:
Tripped over the HDMI cable mid-match? Console died after the power came back from load shedding? PS4 Pro sounding like a jet taking off?

We repair PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 consoles at component level in Silvamonte: HDMI ports and chips, power supplies, disc drives, southbridge faults and overheating. We cover every model, from the original PS4 to the PS5 Slim and PS5 Pro, plus DualSense and DualShock 4 controllers.

A full service with liquid metal re-application starts from R1,500, and controller repairs start from R350. Every console gets a free diagnostic first, and repairs carry a 6-month warranty.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
